name: Being Considerate
overview: Scripture calls believers to reflect a pure heart and gracious speech, fostering peace and friendship as seen in Proverbs 22:11. Jesus teaches the seriousness of harboring anger and using harmful words, warning of judgment for such offenses (Matthew 5:22). The Golden Rule in Matthew 7:12 encapsulates the principle of treating others with the same consideration we desire. Ephesians 4:32 further exhorts kindness, tenderheartedness, and forgiveness, modeling God's grace through Christ. Together, these passages emphasize that being considerate involves controlling our words and attitudes, showing genuine love, and forgiving as God has forgiven us.
